name: Tagaytay Uphill Challenge 2026 (4th Edition)
short_description: The fourth Tagaytay Uphill Challenge is on Sunday 13 December 2026 from Woodside Farm and Waterparks in Cabuyao, Laguna, with 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races.
ai_summary: The Tagaytay Uphill Challenge 4th Edition is on Sunday 13 December 2026, based at Woodside Farm and Waterparks in Barangay Casile, Cabuyao, Laguna, with the start listed at 4:00 am. It offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races, priced from PHP 699 to PHP 1,799 depending on entry period. The organiser is DGB Events Management Services.

core_facts.venue: Woodside Farm and Waterparks, Purok 6, Brgy Casile

faqs.question: When is the Tagaytay Uphill Challenge 2026?
faqs.answer: The fourth edition is on Sunday 13 December 2026, with the start listed at 4:00 am Philippine time on the MyRunTime entry page. Separate gun times for each distance and cut-off times have not been published yet, so check the organiser's race-day advisory before travelling to Cabuyao.

faqs.question: What distances and fees are offered?
faqs.answer: There are three races: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km. Regular fees are PHP 1,799 for 21 km, PHP 1,299 for 10 km and PHP 799 for 5 km; early-bird entries until 10 November cost PHP 1,599, PHP 1,149 and PHP 699. Courier and platform fees are extra.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is based at Woodside Farm and Waterparks in Barangay Casile, Cabuyao, Laguna, in the uplands below the Tagaytay ridge. The event's name signals a hilly course climbing towards the Tagaytay ridge rather than a flat road race, though the route map has not been released yet.
